В данном задании вам необходимо исследов: In this task, you need to investigate the properties of a solar photocell as a source of electrical energy. Use a flashlight as the Sun. To avoid excessive battery drain in the flashlight, turn it on only during measurements. Fix the flashlight and photocell on the table using modeling clay. Make sure the photocell panel is fully illuminated by the flashlight light at all times. If the relative position of the flashlight and photocell changes during measurements, you will need to repeat the measurements. During measurements, cover the flashlight and photocell from external light with the cardboard folder.

To simulate daytime illumination, place the flashlight a few centimeters from the photocell.
